elements.el: Where it lives: settings overlay and triggers file, with no account home path
After a write: change, actor, audit row and undo
Section pills count rows and jump to the named section
Settings: every key as a fact and a closed key select
Settings preview: a diff before the five-minute confirm ticket
Refusal: named key and valid values, nothing changed
Trigger row links, one-based numbering and hidden machine index
Pause window row actions prefill edits and preserve hidden local scope by omission
Scoped limits retain JSON with row-specific prefilled edits
Projects have row numbers and stable-id row edit/delete actions
MCP references and secrets expose names only
Empty pi packages, profiles and bundles keep their own usable panels
Rows and paths come from one snapshot
Secrets, Connections and Project detail destinations
elements.reason: Issue #751 adds these named pages. Secrets and Connections resolve to Configuration meanwhile; project rows are deliberately unlinked until the page exists.
